summary: Wamba territory (Haut-Uele) is held by the state as of October 2026, but its eastern part is exposed to the ADF expansion into southern Haut-Uele. Since May-July 2026 ADF attacks around Mungbere (Watsa) were followed by reported ADF movement toward Betongwe and an incursion contained by the FARDC at the periphery of Wamba town, displacing over 10,000 people; the ADF base area lies in the forest between Mambasa, Wamba and Watsa. Wamba town remains under PNC/state control with FARDC reinforcement, while the eastern villages toward Mungbere are an FARDC operations zone contested by the ADF. The Pawa and Boma-Mangbetu chefferies and the western/central Wamba secteur have no reported armed-group control and are assigned to the PNC by default presence. An Ebola outbreak in Wamba and Pawa health zones compounds insecurity. NOTE: a review pass could not re-check these claims against fresh reporting (web search unavailable); assessment is consistent with neighbouring Watsa and Mambasa assessments.

zones.description: Wamba town (territorial seat, Wamba health zone)
zones.evidence: Territorial seat with state administration and police; FARDC reinforced in the area during the 2026 anti-ADF operations. In July 2026 an ADF incursion was contained by the army at Wamba's periphery and the town received displaced people fleeing the ADF, i.e. it remained state-held.

zones.description: Eastern Wamba secteur toward Watsa/Mungbere and the Ituri forest (Betongwe, Maboma, Selesele, Kossia/Boku health areas, east of ~28.1E)
zones.evidence: After ADF attacks at Mungbere (Watsa) in May-July 2026, rebels were reported moving toward Betongwe, under 100 km from Wamba centre, causing mass displacement; the ADF base area (Suka ya Mboka) lies in the forest between Mambasa, Wamba and Watsa. FARDC are conducting operations and restricting movement on the Isiro-Mungbere axis; no report of lasting ADF occupation of these villages, so the army is assessed as the main force in a contested zone.

zones.description: Rest of Wamba secteur (Bakandja, Bolebole, Mambati/Mopepe, Bayenga, Tshaka Tshaka, Bomana, Asamboa health areas; Carriere Cowete in Nia-Nia health zone)
zones.evidence: No reports of armed-group control in the western and central parts of Wamba secteur; 2026 ADF activity is reported on the eastern side toward Watsa. Armed Mbororo herder incursions (2024) and poaching near the Okapi reserve are sporadic threats without territorial control. Default state presence assumed.

zones.description: Pawa and Boma-Mangbetu chefferies (Pawa, Babonde/Ngoyama, Nebobongo, Ibambi, Boma Mangbetu health zone)
zones.evidence: Western part of the territory toward Isiro; no reports of armed-group presence or control in 2025-2026, with the 2026 ADF push centred on Watsa and eastern Wamba. Ebola (2026 outbreak in Pawa health zone) is the main crisis. Default state presence assumed.
